an9.12:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an9.12:1.2: athakho āyasmā sāriputto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
an9.12:1.4: atippago kho tāva sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ
an9.12:1.5: yannūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti
an9.12:1.6: athakho āyasmā sāriputto yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi
an9.12:1.7: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an9.12:2.1: tena kho pana samayena tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
an9.12:2.2: yo hi koci āvuso saupādiseso kālaṃ karoti sabbo so aparimutto nirayā aparimutto tiracchānayoniyā aparimutto pittivisayā aparimutto apāyaduggativinipātāti.
an9.12:2.3: athakho āyasmā sāriputto tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandi nappaṭikkosi
an9.12:2.5: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmīti
an9.12:2.6: athakho āyasmā sāriputto sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an9.12:3.1: idhāhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ
an9.12:3.3: atippago kho tāva sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ
an9.12:3.4: yannūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti
an9.12:3.5: athakhohaṃ bhante yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃ
an9.12:3.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ
an9.12:3.7: tena kho pana samayena tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
an9.12:3.8: yo hi koci āvuso saupādiseso kālaṃ karoti sabbo so aparimutto nirayā aparimutto tiracchānayoniyā aparimutto pittivisayā aparimutto apāyaduggativinipātāti
an9.12:3.9: athakhohaṃ bhante tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ
an9.12:3.11: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmīti.
an9.12:4.1: keci sāriputta aññatitthiyā paribbājakā bālā abyattā keci saupādisesaṃ vā saupādisesāti jānissanti anupādisesaṃ vā anupādisesāti jānissanti
an9.12:5.1: nava yime sāriputta puggalā saupādisesā kālaṃ kurumānā parimuttā nirayā parimuttā tiracchānayoniyā parimuttā pittivisayā parimuttā apāyaduggativinipātā.
an9.12:5.3: idha sārīputta ekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrīkārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrīkārī paññāya mattasokārī
an9.12:5.4: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibyāyī hoti
an9.12:5.5: ayaṃ sāriputta paṭhamo puggalo saupādiseso kālaṃ kurumāno parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pittivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
an9.12:6.1: puna caparaṃ sāriputta idhekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrīkārī hoti samādhismiṃ paripūrīkārī paññāya mattasokārī
an9.12:6.2: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti
an9.12:6.8: ayaṃ sāriputta pañcamo puggalo saupādiseso kālaṃ kurumāno parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pittivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
an9.12:7.1: puna caparaṃ sāriputta idhekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrīkārī hoti samādhismiṃ mattasokārī paññāya mattasokārī
an9.12:7.2: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an9.12:7.3: ayaṃ sāriputta chaṭṭho puggalo saupādiseso kālaṃ kurumāno parimutto nirayā …pe… parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
an9.12:8.1: puna caparaṃ sāriputta idhekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrīkārī hoti samādhismiṃ mattasokārī paññāya mattasokārī
an9.12:8.2: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā ekabījī hoti ekaṃ yeva mānusakaṃ bhavaṃ nibbattetvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an9.12:8.3: ayaṃ sāriputta sattamo puggalo saupādiseso kālaṃ kurumāno parimutto nirayā …pe… parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
an9.12:9.1: puna caparaṃ sāriputta idhekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrīkārī hoti samādhismiṃ mattasokārī paññāya mattasokārī
an9.12:9.2: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā kolaṃkolo hoti dve vā tīṇi vā kulāni sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an9.12:9.3: ayaṃ sāriputta aṭṭhamo puggalo saupādiseso kālaṃ kurumāno parimutto nirayā …pe… parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
an9.12:10.1: puna caparaṃ sāriputta idhekacco puggalo sīlesu paripūrīkārī hoti samādhismiṃ mattasokārī paññāya mattasokārī
an9.12:10.2: so tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sattakkhattuṃparamo hoti sattakkhattuṃparamaṃ deve ca manusse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti
an9.12:10.3: ayaṃ sāriputta navamo puggalo saupādiseso kālaṃ kurumāno parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pittivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā
an9.12:11.1: keci sāriputta aññatitthiyā paribbājakā bālā abyattā keci saupādisesaṃ vā saupādisesāti jānissanti anupādisesaṃ vā anupādisesāti jānissanti
an9.12:11.2: ime kho sāriputta nava puggalā saupādisesā kālaṃ kurumānā parimuttā nirayā parimuttā tiracchānayoniyā parimuttā pittivisayā parimuttā apāyaduggativinipātā
an9.12:11.3: na tāvāyaṃ sāriputta dhammapariyāyo patibhāsi bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ
an9.12:11.6: api ca mayā yo pañhādhippāyena bhāsitoti. 13
